data.value: An emergency portal that connects needs during a crisis with equipment, vehicles and volunteers who can help.

data.value: For emergency services and crisis management

data.value: Only for emergency services, police and crisis management. Not for private individuals.

data.name: Rett ressurs til rett sted når krisen rammer.
data.value: The right resource in the right place when a crisis hits.

data.name: Strømbrudd, ekstremvær eller evakuering: BeredskapsPortalen samler utstyr, kjøretøy og frivillige på ett sted, slik at kriseledelsen raskt kan sende hjelp dit den trengs.
data.value: Power cuts, extreme weather or evacuation: BeredskapsPortalen gathers equipment, vehicles and volunteers in one place, so crisis management can quickly send help where it is needed.

data.value: If life or health is in danger, call 110, 112 or 113 first.

data.value: Do you need help, or can you help others? Each path has its own short form.

data.value: Choose a type, point to the place on the map and add how you can be reached. It takes less than a minute.

data.name: Meldingen vises på kartet til kriseledelsen med en gang, og de kobler behov med ressurser.
data.value: The report appears on the crisis management map right away, and they match needs with resources.

data.name: Åpne autentiseringsappen og skriv inn den 6-sifrede koden.
data.value: Open the authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.

data.value: Here you can see how you are logged in.

data.name: Kontoen din er beskyttet med kode fra autentiseringsapp.
data.value: Your account is protected with a code from an authenticator app.

data.value: Two-factor login gives extra protection if someone gets hold of your password.

data.value: Turn on 2FA under My account. If you already have 2FA, log out and log in again with the code from the app.
